meta: How to reply to angry customers with AI: understand what they need and write a gentle reply without making promises you can't keep.

muc.title: Correct but still angry
muc.text: An angry customer who gets a robotic reply gets twice as angry, even if you didn't get a single word wrong.

muc.title: What the customer really needs
muc.text: Remove names and order numbers, paste the message into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask what the customer needs most.

muc.title: Three points in a reply
muc.text: Ask AI for a three-point draft: acknowledge the feelings, say clearly what you'll do, and give a specific time.

muc.title: No reckless promises
muc.text: Always reread before sending. Don't let AI promise refunds or compensation the company hasn't approved.

muc.title: Soften a dry reply
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to rewrite a dry reply so it's softer but still follows policy.
